note: E1 consumes the shared student registry (dicode.student_adapters) — it never constructs a second loader / registry / checkpoint codec. The shared registry is absent in this worktree, so every mount stays honestly STUDENT_SHARED_REGISTRY_UNBOUND and no real Smoke / probe / update runs.
selection_rule: the director-selected candidate id is REQUIRED (no default); the CLI can never override the Runtime Bundle's issued identity; one Student per run only
training_rule: training flows ONLY through the director-injected CanonicalDiCodeOneUpdateRuntime + CanonicalDiCodeRunStateCheckpoint; the read-only RMT16 adapter can never impersonate a training runtime
